mentions.story: Launch HN: Living Carbon (YC W20) – Trees that capture and store more carbon
mentions.why: Back-of-envelope math on trees needed to offset US emissions
mentions.quote: to offset the US CO2 emissions, you need to plant about 20 million trees PER DAY

mentions.author: danuker
mentions.why: Planting 20 million trees offsets about half a day of US CO2
mentions.quote: planting 20 million trees would equal roughly the CO2 emissions of the USA for half a day.
